newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea Jinro Group shares go limit up at opening.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea Jinro Group shares go limit up at opening.

text.p: Shares in troubled Jinro Group went limit up at the opening on Friday on investor optimism creditor banks would extend emergency loans to help bail out the South Korea's 19th largest conglomerate, brokers said.
Flagship Jinro Ltd gained 490 won to 6,710, Jinro General Foods, 290 won to 3,950 and Jinro Industries 330 won to 4,490.
Brokers said investors were raising their hopes that creditors would not let the group default on their debts.
Creditor banks are due to meet at 0530 GMT to discuss the future of Jinro Group as its bail-out protection will expire on Sunday.
But a Commerical Bank of Korea official said nothing had been yet decided.
